verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting and bookkeeping service, so chart-of-accounts customization is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows Pilot itself lets an accountant customize account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions. The QuickBooks references describe the host ledger platform, and "Custom workflows and reporting" is an adjacent feature, not COA customization.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
